QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Neinheart's Message
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart refused to participate until Claudine jumped in. Talk to Neinheart again.
QuestInfo.1:
You wanted to help Neinheart record his message, but he refused. He thinks no one can help complete his mission. However, he did say you should come back #bin 30 minutes when his pocket watch goes off#k.

(*Watch out! Neinheart's pocket watch disappears if you log out.)
QuestInfo.2: Talk to Neinheart again to get the finished message.

default.0: I'm waiting for someone.\r\nDon't rush me. It hasn't been 30 minutes yet.
